name: Squat to box
why: Strong legs push you off the ground for a dive or a high catch, and sitting back to a box teaches a safe squat shape.

setup.space: About 1 m by 1 m of floor in front of the box.
setup.equipment: A stable low box or step that does not slide.
setup.parent: Stand side-on, about 2 m away, where you can see knees and back.

steps: Stand a short step in front of the box, feet about shoulder width, toes turned out a little.
Reach both arms forward and push your hips back as if sitting down.
Lower until you lightly touch the box. Do not sit down or relax.
Push through the whole foot to stand tall again.

mistakes.fix: Push the knees out so they point the same way as the toes.
Slow the last part down and only brush the box.
Keep your weight over the middle of the foot and sit back more.

parent_check: Knees stay over the toes on every rep
stop_if: Pain in the knee, hip or lower back, or pain that changes how you move
Chest pain, dizziness, feeling faint, a racing heartbeat or unusual shortness of breath
Knees keep caving in after a reminder (end the set)

easier.variant: Shorter range: stop halfway down and come back up.
easier.use_when: Knees cave in or heels lift.

harder.variant: Pause for two seconds just above the box before standing.
harder.move_on_when: Every rep clean in two sessions in a row, and the owner approves the change.

dose.tempo: down slow for three, stand up smoothly
